claim_text: Official account: overloaded legacy telecom switches and routers
summary: Duffy said on the record at the White House briefing (Reuters, BBC, LA Times, Aviation Week) that legacy analog TDM (time-division multiplexing) switches and routers carrying ATC voice and radar data were overloaded with data…
detail: Duffy said on the record at the White House briefing (Reuters, BBC, LA Times, Aviation Week) that legacy analog TDM (time-division multiplexing) switches and routers carrying ATC voice and radar data were overloaded with data, began giving inconsistent data at 3:36 PM ET, and the FAA shut the system down; radar and communications were never fully lost. Mullin said new equipment being added was overwhelming the older system. This confirms what officials said, not an independent finding; no written FAA report, transcript, vendor or specific upgrade has been named.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Mullin said new equipment being added was overwhelming the older system. This confirms what officials said, not an independent finding; no written FAA report, transcript, vendor or specific upgrade has been named.

claim_text: Saturday: Duffy names L3Harris copper-to-fiber work at a remote FAA site
summary: At the 10:30 AM ET Saturday DOT briefing with FAA Administrator Bedford, Duffy said the outage began while L3Harris Technologies, which runs the network, was switching lines from copper wire to fiber at a remote FAA site…
detail: At the 10:30 AM ET Saturday DOT briefing with FAA Administrator Bedford, Duffy said the outage began while L3Harris Technologies, which runs the network, was switching lines from copper wire to fiber at a remote FAA site, and a router involved in that work flooded the rest of the system, disrupting communications with aircraft and radar (Yahoo News live coverage; AInvest wire headline). This confirms what Duffy said, not a finding: officials have not determined whether the router was faulty or the contractor erred ("Was it the router, or were they not doing great work for us at L3Harris?"). The site was not named, no written FAA report is posted, and L3Harris had not commented. The CBS software-update/reboot account stays Reported.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: This confirms what Duffy said, not a finding: officials have not determined whether the router was faulty or the contractor erred ("Was it the router, or were they not doing great work for us at L3Harris?").

The label here has not been changed.
